description: Execution-mode transactions (type 0x2, dynamic fee) signed by go-qrl's types.SignTx with types.NewZondSigner(chainId) at the go-qrl commit qrysm pins. Account i's extended seed is 01 00 00 followed by the first 48 bytes of SHA-512("go-remotesigner transaction vector account " ‖ decimal i). request is the qrl_signTransaction transaction object; signing_hash is ZondSigner.Hash with the descriptor 01 00 00 and empty extraParams, which the signature covers. deterministic holds the encoded signed transaction (raw) and its hash when the account signs in ML-DSA-87's deterministic mode; the signer signs hedged, so only its signing hash matches these in production. These are test keys: never use them on a live network. Generated by tools/vectorgen; data only, dedicated to the public domain under CC0-1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
